I need to determine the additional clockwise rotation in degrees, within the range [0, 360), required to align the current object's facing direction with the reference direction.

The difference between facing downward (which is the opposite of the reference direction) and facing upward is 135 degrees. Therefore, the additional clockwise rotation needed is 135 degrees.
